verdict.rationale: Factory documents headless `droid exec` for CI/CD pipelines, shell scripts, and batch processing, so recurring runs are possible by triggering it from an external scheduler such as cron or a CI schedule. Software Factory also mentions "persistent automations" and putting review, QA, and docs "on autopilot," but none of the evidence shows a native scheduler, cron syntax, or recurrence configuration. Missing for 10: a documented first-party scheduling/recurrence feature, configuration details for recurring automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
